If you have rare goods, send some to us.” I answered: “We have drifted for long, and all the things we brought have been scattered in the sea. If you show me a way to live, the boat and its gear that we came in are all yours.” And I asked how far the human dwellings were. One man said: “This place is also near the government office; if you want to go, no harm.” One said: “Past one li ahead there are houses.” One said: “The houses here are far; you cannot stay here.” I further asked: “How far is the official road?” One of them said: “Taizhou Prefecture is one hundred and eighty li from here.” One said: “One hundred and fifty li.” One said: “Two hundred and forty li.” Their statements contradicted one another, and could not be trusted. These men noisily crowded in, vying to enter my boat, and whatever caught their eye, however trifling, they seized. They said to us: “If you don’t go with us, we shall get angry.” An Ui proposed that we abandon the boat and ride in their boat, to follow wherever they went. Yi Jeong wanted to strike one man dead to drive them back. I said: “Your plans are both wrong. Looking at those men, their words are not true and their plundering is great; the depth of their sincerity or falsity cannot be known. If they are of the kind of the Xiashan sea-robbers, then if we follow An Ui’s plan and go back with them, they will surely row us to a remote island and sink and kill us to destroy their traces. If they are fishing boats or guard boats, then if we follow Yi Jeong’s plan and strike one dead, they will surely cover up what they did and say instead that we foreigners came to rob and kill people; then the great country’s frontier will be in uproar, we shall be falsely called robbers, our speech will not be understood, it will be hard to clear ourselves, and we shall all be cut down by border commanders. Both your plans are paths by which we bring death upon ourselves; better to use a pretext and watch how things develop.” I said to those men: “We have been many days afloat, and at the extreme of hunger, thirst and exhaustion, our lives hang by a single thread. Please let us cook rice to ease the hunger, and then we will go together.” The men replied: “You rest a while and go slowly.” They at once rowed their boat back some two or three li, and again encircled my boat and moored. Because of the rain, they all went into the cabins of their boat, and there were none watching.

paragraphs.orig: 臣謂同舟人曰：「看彼人言語動止也甚荒唐。看此山已連陸路，必通人居，不於此時善處，則我等之命懸其掌握，終必為海曲之鬼。」遂率陪吏等先下船，諸軍人接踵而下，冒雨穿林逃遁奔匿。過二嶺，嶺皆枕海，有石如甬道。行六七里，得一里社。臣謂陪吏、軍人等曰：「同此生死之苦，無異骨肉之親。自此相保，則可以全身而還。汝等若遇患難則同救之，得一飯則分吃之，有疾病則相扶持之，無一人亡失可也。」皆曰：「唯命。」又曰：「我國本禮義之國，雖漂奔窘遽之間，亦當示以威儀，使此地人知我國禮節如是。凡所到處，陪吏等拜跪於我，軍人等拜跪於陪吏，無有過差。且或於里前，或於城中，有群聚來觀者，必作揖禮，無敢肆突！」皆曰：「唯命。」至其里，則里中人——老少男女——爭怪臣等，觀者如牆。臣與從者趨而揖，皆合袖鞠躬以答之。臣即告以來自朝鮮之故。
paragraphs.reading: 신위동주인왈: 「간피인언어동지야심황당. 간차산이련륙로, 필통인거, 불어차시선처, 칙아등지명현기장악, 종필위해곡지귀.」수솔배리등선하선, 제군인접종이하, 모우천림도둔분닉. 과이령, 영개침해, 유석여용도. 행육칠리, 득일이사. 신위배리, 군인등왈: 「동차생사지고, 무이골육지친. 자차상보, 칙가이전신이환. 여등약우환난칙동구지, 득일반칙분흘지, 유질병칙상부지지, 무일인망실가야.」개왈: 「유명.」우왈: 「아국본예의지국, 수표분군거지간, 역당시이위의, 사차지인지아국예절여시. 범소도처, 배리등배궤어아, 군인등배궤어배리, 무유과차. 차혹어이전, 혹어성중, 유군취래관자, 필작읍례, 무감사돌!」개왈: 「유명.」지기리, 칙이중인——노소남녀——쟁괴신등, 관자여장. 신여종자추이읍, 개합수국궁이답지. 신즉고이래자조선지고.
paragraphs.en: I said to the men of my boat: “Looking at the words and behaviour of those men, they are quite preposterous. This mountain is already joined to a land route and must lead to human dwellings; if we do not deal well with it at this time, our lives will hang in their grasp and in the end we shall be ghosts of the sea’s bend.” So I led the attendant clerks and the others first off the boat, and the soldiers followed on our heels; in the rain we passed through woods, fleeing and hiding. We crossed two ridges, which both pillowed the sea, with stones lying like a paved path. After six or seven li we came to a village shrine. I said to the attendant clerks, the soldiers and the others: “Sharing this suffering of life and death, we are no different from flesh and blood. From now on, if we protect one another, we can return with our bodies whole. If any of you meets trouble, save each other; if you get a meal, share it; if you fall ill, support each other; let no one be lost.” All said: “We obey your command.” I also said: “Our country is by origin a land of ritual and righteousness; even in the hurry of fleeing and drifting we should show dignified bearing, so that the people here know that our country’s ceremonial is like this. Wherever we come, the attendant clerks are to kneel to me, and the soldiers kneel to the attendant clerks, without error. And whether in front of a village or in a city, if crowds gather to watch, make a bow with clasped hands, and let none dare to be rude!” All said: “We obey your command.” On reaching the village, the people of the village — old and young, men and women — vied in marvelling at us, and the onlookers were like a wall. I and my followers hastened forward and bowed; all answered with sleeves joined and bowing. I told them at once the reason we had come from Joseon.

paragraphs.orig: 有二人，其容貌諒非庸人，謂臣等曰：「你是朝鮮國人，緣何入我國界？你若是賊人，若是進貢之人，若是被風無定之人，逐一寫來，遞送還國。」臣曰：「我本朝鮮國臣，奉王命往海島。奔父喪，過海遭風，見漂得到海岸，舍舟緣陸，望尋人煙而來，乞諸大人聞於官府，以活垂死之命。」即以所齎印信、冠帶、文書示之。其二人覽畢，指臣前鎮撫、陪吏等以次羅跪，末端軍人等亦以次俯伏。謂臣曰：「聞貴國禮義邦久矣，果協所聞。」即叫家僮將米漿、茶、酒以饋，遍及軍人，任其所飲。指里前佛堂曰：「你可住此堂安歇。」臣至佛堂，解濕衣以風。未幾，其二人又做飯來饋，果皆忠厚人也，而亡其職、姓名。俄而，其二人來言：「你可起身，送你好處。」臣問曰：「好處幾里？」其二人謊詞曰：「還有二里。」曰：「其地名何？」曰：「西里堂也。」曰：「雨甚，路濘，時又向晚，奈何？」曰：「去處不遠，不須憂矣。」臣從其言，率從者登途而行。則里中人或帶杖劍或擊錚鼓。前途有聞錚鼓之聲者，群聚如雲，叫號隳突，夾左右擁前後而驅，次次遞送。前里如是，後里又如是。行過五十餘里，夜已央矣。
paragraphs.reading: 유이인, 기용모양비용인, 위신등왈: 「이시조선국인, 연하입아국계? 이약시적인, 약시진공지인, 약시피풍무정지인, 축일사래, 체송환국.」신왈: 「아본조선국신, 봉왕명왕해도. 분부상, 과해조풍, 견표득도해안, 사주연륙, 망심인연이래, 걸제대인문어관부, 이활수사지명.」즉이소재인신, 관대, 문서시지. 기이인남필, 지신전진무, 배리등이차나궤, 말단군인등역이차부복. 위신왈: 「문귀국예의방구의, 과협소문.」즉규가동장미장, 다, 주이궤, 편급군인, 임기소음. 지이전불당왈: 「이가주차당안헐.」신지불당, 해습의이풍. 미기, 기이인우주반래궤, 과개충후인야, 이망기직, 성명. 아이, 기이인래언: 「이가기신, 송이호처.」신문왈: 「호처기리?」기이인황사왈: 「환유이리.」왈: 「기지명하?」왈: 「서리당야.」왈: 「우심, 노녕, 시우향만, 내하?」왈: 「거처불원, 불수우의.」신종기언, 솔종자등도이행. 칙이중인혹대장검혹격쟁고. 전도유문쟁고지성자, 군취여운, 규호휴돌, 협좌우옹전후이구, 차차체송. 전리여시, 후리우여시. 행과오십여리, 야이앙의.
paragraphs.en: There were two men whose looks were certainly not those of common men; they said to us: “You are people of Joseon; how did you come into our borders? Whether you are robbers, tribute-bearers or people blown by the wind without direction, write it all down one by one, and you will be sent back to your country in relays.” I said: “I am originally a subject of Joseon, sent by royal command to an island in the sea. Hastening to my father’s funeral, I crossed the sea and met a storm, was blown here and reached the coast; leaving the boat and following the land I came looking for the smoke of human habitation; I beg you, gentlemen, to report to the government, so that a life at the point of death may be saved.” And I showed them the seal, cap and sash, and documents I had brought. After reading them, the two men pointed to my pacification officer and the attendant clerks in front of me, who knelt in order in a row, and the soldiers at the end also prostrated themselves in order. They said to me: “We have long heard that your honoured country is a land of ritual and righteousness; indeed it accords with what we heard.” They then called their household boys to bring rice-water, tea and wine to give us, extending to the soldiers, and let them drink as they pleased. They pointed to the Buddhist hall in front of the village and said: “You may stay in this hall and rest.” I went to the hall and took off my wet clothes to air them. Before long the two men again cooked rice and brought it to feed us; they were indeed loyal and honest men, but I have lost their positions and names. Shortly afterwards the two men came and said: “You can rise and set off; we shall send you to a good place.” I asked: “How many li is the good place?” The two men lied: “Two li more.” “What is the name of the place?” “It is Xilitang.” “The rain is heavy, the road muddy, and it is also near evening; what then?” “The place is not far; no need to worry.” I followed their words and led my followers on the road. Then the people of the village, some carrying staves and swords, some beating gongs and drums, came out. Those ahead who heard the sound of gongs and drums gathered like clouds, shouting, charging and pushing, pressing in on left and right, thronging front and back and driving us on, sending us on one after another. As the first village did, so the next village did again. We went more than fifty li, and the night was already deep.

paragraphs.orig: ## △十八日
paragraphs.en: 18th day

paragraphs.orig: 遇千戶許清於路上。是日大雨。子半，臣等因為里人所驅，路經一高阜，松竹成藪。遇有自稱隱儒，姓王名乙源者，憐臣冒夜衝雨，艱楚被驅，止里人，少住。問臣所從來。臣亦告以漂風之故。乙源惻然，即呼酒勸臣。臣曰：「我朝鮮人守親喪，不飲酒、食肉、茹葷及甘旨之味，以終三年。蒙饋酒，感恩則已深矣，然我今當喪，敢辭。」乙源遂饋臣以茶，饋從者以酒。因問曰：「你國亦有佛否？」答曰：「我國不崇佛法，專尚儒術，家家皆以孝悌忠信為業。」乙源握臣手，眷顧相別。其里人驅臣等至一大嶺。臣足如繭不能前進。里人擁挽臣臂，前引後推而過。又遞至二十餘里，其里中有大橋，里人皆揮棱杖亂擊臣等，肆虣劫奪太甚。吳山者負臣馬鞍，有一人毆擊攘去。臣等被杖前驅，顛仆哭泣，過二嶺，見遞他里。向曙，問其有大橋之里，則人曰：「仙岩里也。」自登陸以來，道旁觀者皆揮臂指頸作斬頭之狀，以示臣等，莫知其意。行至蒲峰里，雨少止。
paragraphs.reading: 우천호허청어로상. 시일대우. 자반, 신등인위이인소구, 노경일고부, 송죽성수. 우유자칭은유, 성왕명을원자, 연신모야충우, 간초피구, 지이인, 소주. 문신소종래. 신역고이표풍지고. 을원측연, 즉호주권신. 신왈: 「아조선인수친상, 불음주, 식육, 여훈급감지지미, 이종삼년. 몽궤주, 감은칙이심의, 연아금당상, 감사.」을원수궤신이다, 궤종자이주. 인문왈: 「이국역유불부?」답왈: 「아국불숭불법, 전상유술, 가가개이효제충신위업.」을원악신수, 권고상별. 기이인구신등지일대령. 신족여견불능전진. 이인옹만신비, 전인후추이과. 우체지이십여리, 기이중유대교, 이인개휘능장난격신등, 사포겁탈태심. 오산자부신마안, 유일인구격양거. 신등피장전구, 전부곡읍, 과이령, 견체타리. 향서, 문기유대교지리, 칙인왈: 「선암리야.」자등륙이래, 도방관자개휘비지경작참두지상, 이시신등, 막지기의. 행지포봉리, 우소지.
paragraphs.en: Met Qianhu Xu Qing on the road. That day heavy rain. At the middle of the zi hour, I and my company, driven by villagers, passed a high mound where pine and bamboo formed a thicket. We met a man who called himself a hermit scholar, surnamed Wang and named Yiyuan, who, pitying me travelling by night through rain, driven in hardship, stopped the villagers and let us rest a while. He asked where I had come from. I told him too the reason for our drift in the storm. Yiyuan was moved to pity and at once called for wine to press on me. I said: “We people of Joseon, keeping a parent’s mourning, do not drink wine, eat meat, eat pungent vegetables or sweet and savoury tastes, until the three years end. That you offer me wine, I am already deeply grateful, but as I am now in mourning I dare to decline.” Yiyuan then offered me tea and offered my followers wine. He asked: “Does your country too have Buddhism?” I answered: “My country does not honour the Buddhist law but exclusively esteems the Confucian arts; every household takes filial piety, brotherly respect, loyalty and good faith as its business.” Yiyuan held my hand and parted from me with tender regard. The villagers drove us to a great ridge. My feet were callused like cocoons and could not advance. The villagers held my arms and hauled me, pulling in front and pushing behind, and so we passed. We were again sent on twenty or more li, where in the village there was a big bridge; the villagers all waved clubs and struck us wildly, extremely violent and rapacious in their plunder. O San, who was carrying my saddle on his back, was beaten by one man who snatched it away. We, beaten with sticks and driven on, fell down weeping, crossed two ridges, and were passed on to another village. Towards dawn, when I asked about the village with the big bridge, someone said: “It is Xianyan village.” Ever since landing, onlookers by the roadside had all waved their arms and pointed at their necks in the gesture of beheading, to show us, and we did not know what they meant. Going on, we reached Pufeng village, where the rain eased a little.

paragraphs.orig: 有官人率軍吏而來，問臣曰：「你是何國人？怎麼到此？」臣曰：「我乃朝鮮國人，再登文科，為國王近臣，奉國事巡海島，奔喪出陸，遭風漂到於此。饑渴萬死之餘，僅續殘命，復為里人所驅，辛苦萬端之極，得遇官人於此，是我得生之時也。」其官人即先饋臣以粥，隨以飯具，又令臣從者做飯以吃。臣問官人姓名、職事，有王適者曰：「此乃海門衛千戶許清也，守塘頭寨，聞倭犯界，專為捕獲而來。汝其慎之！」臣困臥路周，四肢莫舉。許清謂臣曰：「我大唐法度嚴切，你別處人不可久在此亂為，攪擾良民。」令軍吏等疾驅臣等，行五里許，有官廨乃塘頭寨也。過一長堤，可十餘里，雨復大作。臣跛行蹣跚，全未動腳，中途僵仆，曰：「我之筋力竭矣，將及於死。早知若此，莫如死於海上之為便！」程保以下亦對臣痛哭。被軍吏甚督，莫能少留。李幀、孝枝、尚理、玄山等身實者，相遞負臣以行。過二嶺，幾至三十餘里，有人居，甚繁盛，前有佛宇。天將暮，雨不止，故許清欲留臣等於佛宇以經夜。其里人皆以謂不可。許清謂臣曰：「此方人皆疑你為劫賊，故不許留你。雖艱步，不可不行。」令軍吏驅臣等過一大嶺。夜二更，至一川邊。
paragraphs.reading: 유관인솔군리이래, 문신왈: 「이시하국인? 즘마도차?」신왈: 「아내조선국인, 재등문과, 위국왕근신, 봉국사순해도, 분상출륙, 조풍표도어차. 기갈만사지여, 근속잔명, 부위이인소구, 신고만단지극, 득우관인어차, 시아득생지시야.」기관인즉선궤신이죽, 수이반구, 우영신종자주반이흘. 신문관인성명, 직사, 유왕적자왈: 「차내해문위천호허청야, 수당두채, 문왜범계, 전위포획이래. 여기신지!」신곤와노주, 사지막거. 허청위신왈: 「아대당법도엄절, 이별처인불가구재차난위, 교요양민.」영군리등질구신등, 행오리허, 유관해내당두채야. 과일장제, 가십여리, 우부대작. 신파행만산, 전미동각, 중도강부, 왈: 「아지근력갈의, 장급어사. 조지약차, 막여사어해상지위편!」정보이하역대신통곡. 피군리심독, 막능소류. 이정, 효지, 상리, 현산등신실자, 상체부신이행. 과이령, 기지삼십여리, 유인거, 심번성, 전유불우. 천장모, 우부지, 고허청욕류신등어불우이경야. 기이인개이위불가. 허청위신왈: 「차방인개의이위겁적, 고불허류이. 수간보, 불가불행.」영군리구신등과일대령. 야이경, 지일천변.
paragraphs.en: An official came leading military clerks, and asked me: “What country are you from? How did you come here?” I said: “I am a man of Joseon, who passed the literary examination twice and am a close subject of the king; sent on state business to tour the islands, I was returning by land to a funeral, met a storm and drifted here. After ten thousand deaths of hunger and thirst I barely prolonged what remained of my life, and was again driven by villagers, in the extreme of countless hardships; to meet an official here is the time when I am to live.” The official first fed me gruel, followed by cooked rice and utensils, and also had my followers cook rice and eat. I asked the official’s name and duty, and one Wang Shi said: “This is Qianhu Xu Qing of Haimen Guard, who guards Tangtou Fort; hearing that Japanese pirates had violated the border, he came solely to capture them. You had better be careful!” I lay exhausted by the roadside, unable to lift my limbs. Xu Qing said to me: “Our Great Tang’s laws are strict; you people from elsewhere may not stay long here making disturbance and harassing good people.” He ordered the military clerks to drive us quickly on; after about five li there was an official building, which was Tangtou Fort. We crossed a long embankment of ten li or so, and the rain fell heavily again. I limped and staggered, not moving my feet at all, and collapsed midway, saying: “My strength is exhausted, and I am about to die. Had I known it would be so, better to have died on the sea!” Jeong Bo and those below also wept bitterly with me. Pressed hard by the military clerks, I could not stay even a moment. Yi Jeong, Hyoji, Sangni, Hyeonsan and others, who were sturdy, carried me in turns. We crossed two ridges, almost thirty li or more, where there were dwellings, very prosperous, with a Buddhist temple in front. Dusk was falling and the rain did not stop, so Xu Qing wanted to keep us at the temple for the night. The villagers all said no. Xu Qing said to me: “The people here all suspect you of being robbers, so they do not allow you to stay. Though your steps are hard, you must go.” He ordered the military clerks to drive us over a great ridge. At the second watch of the night we reached a stream bank.

paragraphs.orig: 李幀等亦力盡，身且不保，不克負臣。從者等亦皆疲羸不能行。許清親執臣手以起，臣之兩足尰蹇，不運一步。高以福大怒，指臣曰：「此漢，此漢！無乃病狂歟？汝若艱苦，宜委四肢，莫之能起可也。」臣辱其言，自以謂我寧至死宜死於此地，復臥不起。從者率皆顛臥狼藉。許清令軍吏或督或毆，而不得驅焉。良久，又有一官人領兵擁炬而至。甲胄、槍劍、彭排之盛，嗩呐、哮羅、喇叭、錚鼓、銃熥之聲，卒然重匝，拔劍使槍，以試擊刺之狀。臣等驚駭耳目，喪魂褫魄，罔知所為。官人與許清整軍威驅臣等，可三四里，有大屋舍繚以城郭，如關防然。問之則乃杜瀆場，見桃渚所，或云批驗所也。城中又有安性寺，止臣等於寺，許留宿焉。臣問其官人為誰？則有僧云：「此乃桃渚所千戶也，聞倭人犯境，領器械以備於此。因許千戶之報，率兵往驅你輩以來。然未知你心真詐，明日到桃渚所將訊汝。」
paragraphs.reading: 이정등역력진, 신차불보, 불극부신. 종자등역개피리불능행. 허청친집신수이기, 신지양족종건, 불운일보. 고이복대로, 지신왈: 「차한, 차한! 무내병광여? 여약간고, 의위사지, 막지능기가야.」신욕기언, 자이위아영지사의사어차지, 부와불기. 종자솔개전와낭자. 허청영군리혹독혹구, 이부득구언. 양구, 우유일관인영병옹거이지. 갑주, 창검, 팽배지성, 쇄눌, 효라, 나팔, 쟁고, 총통지성, 졸연중잡, 발검사창, 이시격자지상. 신등경해이목, 상혼치백, 망지소위. 관인여허청정군위구신등, 가삼사리, 유대옥사료이성곽, 여관방연. 문지칙내두독장, 견도저소, 혹운비험소야. 성중우유안성사, 지신등어사, 허류숙언. 신문기관인위수? 칙유승운: 「차내도저소천호야, 문왜인범경, 영기계이비어차. 인허천호지보, 솔병왕구이배이래. 연미지이심진사, 명일도도저소장신여.」
paragraphs.en: Yi Jeong and the others were also out of strength, could not protect even themselves, and were unable to carry me. My followers also were all weak and could not walk. Xu Qing himself took my hand to raise me, but my two feet were swollen and lame and I could not take a single step. Go Ibok flew into a great rage and, pointing at me, said: “This fellow, this fellow! Is he not mad? If you are in hardship you should drop your limbs and be unable to rise — that would be all right.” I was insulted by his words, and thinking that I would rather die, if die I must, in this very place, lay down again and did not rise. My followers were all thrown down in disorder. Xu Qing had the military clerks urge or beat us, but could not drive us on. After a long while another official came leading troops, with torches. The splendour of armour, spears and swords, and shields, and the sounds of suona, conches, trumpets, gongs, drums and guns, suddenly surrounded us in several rings, and they drew swords and wielded spears as if to try out the gestures of thrusting and striking. Our ears and eyes were startled, our souls and spirits taken, and we knew not what to do. The official and Xu Qing assembled their military might and drove us on some three or four li, where there were buildings surrounded by walls, like a barrier-defence. Asked, it was Dudu Yard, which was reckoned as belonging to Taozhu Garrison, though some said it was an inspection office. In the town was also Anxing Temple; they put us in the temple and permitted us to lodge there. I asked who the official was, and a monk said: “This is the Qianhu of Taozhu Garrison; hearing that the Japanese had violated the border, he led men with weapons to guard here. Because of Qianhu Xu’s report, he led troops to drive you here. But we do not yet know whether your hearts are true or false; tomorrow when you reach Taozhu Garrison they will interrogate you.”

paragraphs.orig: ## △十九日
paragraphs.en: 19th day

paragraphs.orig: 到桃渚所。是日大雨。兩千戶並馬驅臣等冒雨以行。臣令程保告許清曰：「我等漂海，浮沉饑渴，臨死復甦，僅保餘喘，得到貴境，得遇官人，得飽昨朝之飯，以為得再生之地。乃於霖霪之雨、濘潦之途，顛坑仆谷，撥石衝泥，體凍腳微，心焦力盡。昨夕不得食，今早又不得食。又驅出，冒大雨而行，我其殆將半途而斃矣。」許清復曰：「昨因你走不到官司，自取饑。今若便到，則官自供給，速去，速去！」臣運步不得，仆路隈，四體委地不收。孝子、程保、金重、莫金、萬山、巨伊山等環坐痛哭。適有牽牛而過者，程保告諸千戶曰：「請解衣買此牛以騎我員。」許清曰：「我亦豈不憐你輩受此苦乎？緣拘國法未得護汝耳。」李楨，孝技、尚理等又相代負臣過一嶺，可二十餘里，至一城乃海門衛之桃渚所。行將近城七八里間，軍卒帶甲束戟，銃熥、彭排夾道填街。至其城，則城有重門，門有鐵扃，城上列建警戍之樓。城中市店聯絡，人物繁富。引臣等至一公館，許留焉。臣之形容槁枯，冠服塗泥，觀者絕倒。
paragraphs.reading: 도도저소. 시일대우. 양천호병마구신등모우이행. 신영정보고허청왈: 「아등표해, 부침기갈, 임사부소, 근보여천, 득도귀경, 득우관인, 득포작조지반, 이위득재생지지. 내어임음지우, 영료지도, 전갱부곡, 발석충니, 체동각미, 심초력진. 작석부득식, 금조우부득식. 우구출, 모대우이행, 아기태장반도이폐의.」허청부왈: 「작인이주부도관사, 자취기. 금약편도, 칙관자공급, 속거, 속거!」신운보부득, 부로외, 사체위지불수. 효자, 정보, 김중, 막금, 만산, 거이산등환좌통곡. 적유견우이과자, 정보고제천호왈: 「청해의매차우이기아원.」허청왈: 「아역기불연이배수차고호? 연구국법미득호여이.」이정, 효기, 상리등우상대부신과일령, 가이십여리, 지일성내해문위지도저소. 행장근성칠팔리간, 군졸대갑속극, 총통, 팽배협도전가. 지기성, 칙성유중문, 문유철경, 성상열건경수지루. 성중시점연락, 인물번부. 인신등지일공관, 허류언. 신지형용고고, 관복도니, 관자절도.
paragraphs.en: Arrived at Taozhu Garrison. That day heavy rain. The two Qianhu rode side by side and drove us through the rain. I had Jeong Bo tell Xu Qing: “We drifted on the sea, floated and sank, hungry and thirsty, revived at the verge of death and barely preserved a remnant breath; reaching your honoured border and meeting officials, we got to eat our fill of yesterday morning’s meal and thought we had found a place of second life. But in the incessant rain and the muddy road, we fell into pits and collapsed in valleys, pushing aside stones and trampling mud, our bodies frozen, our feet weak, our hearts scorched and strength spent. Last evening we could not eat, and this morning again could not eat. We were again driven out and go on through heavy rain; I shall probably die half-way.” Xu Qing replied: “Yesterday, because you could not walk to the official post, you brought hunger on yourselves. Now, if you arrive at once, the authorities will supply you themselves; hurry, hurry!” I could not move my steps, and collapsed at a bend of the road, my four limbs lying on the ground, not to be gathered up. Hyoja, Jeong Bo, Kim Jung, Makgeum, Mansan, Geoisan and the others sat around me in tears. By chance a man passed leading an ox; Jeong Bo said to the Qianhu: “Please let us take off our clothes and buy this ox for our gentleman to ride.” Xu Qing said: “Do I not pity you for suffering this? But bound by the law of the state, I cannot protect you.” Yi Jeong, Hyoji, Sangni and the others again took turns carrying me over a ridge, about twenty li, to a walled town which was Taozhu Garrison of Haimen Guard. For seven or eight li as we approached the town, soldiers in armour and with halberds bundled, with guns and shields, lined the road and filled the street. When we reached the town, the town had double gates, the gates had iron bars, and on the wall stood towers for guard. In the town, markets and shops were linked together, and people and goods abundant. They led us to a public lodging and allowed us to stay. My appearance was gaunt and withered, and my cap and clothes smeared with mud; onlookers fell about with laughter.

paragraphs.orig: 有姓名王碧者，寫謂臣曰：「昨日已報上司，倭船十四隻犯邊劫人，你果是倭乎？」臣曰：「我非倭，乃朝鮮國文士也。」又有姓名盧夫容者，自稱措大，謂臣曰：「車同軌，書同文，獨你語音不同中國，何也？」臣答曰：「千里不同風，百里不同俗。足下怪聽我言，我亦怪聽足下之言，習俗然也。然同得天所賦之性，則我之性亦堯舜孔顏之性，豈嫌於語音之有異哉？」其人撫掌曰：「你奔喪，可行朱文公《家禮》乎？」臣答曰：「我國人守喪皆一遵《家禮》，我當從之。但為風所逆，迨今不得哭於柩前，所以痛哭。」其人又問曰：「你作詩否？」臣答曰：「詩詞乃輕薄子嘲弄風月之資，非學道篤實君子所為也。我以格致誠正為學，不用意學夫詩詞也。若或有人先倡，不得不和耳。」又有一人寫臣掌上曰：「看你也不是歹人，衹以言語不同，實同盲啞，誠可憐也。我告你一言，你其記之，善自處，慎勿輕與人言。自古倭賊屢劫我邊境，故國家設備倭都指揮、備倭把總官以備之。若獲倭，則皆先斬後聞。今你初繫舟處，轄獅子塞之地，守寨官誣汝為倭，欲獻馘圖功，故先報云：『倭船十四隻犯邊劫人』。將領兵往捕汝斬汝之時，你輩先自舍舟投入人多之里，故不得逞其謀矣。明日把總官來訊你輩。你其詳辨之，少有違誤，事在不測」云云。臣問其姓名，則曰：「我所以言之者，愛汝也，危之也！」掉頭而去。臣聞其言，毛髮豎立，即語程保等。
paragraphs.reading: 유성명왕벽자, 사위신왈: 「작일이보상사, 왜선십사척범변겁인, 이과시왜호?」신왈: 「아비왜, 내조선국문사야.」우유성명노부용자, 자칭조대, 위신왈: 「차동궤, 서동문, 독이어음부동중국, 하야?」신답왈: 「천리부동풍, 백리부동속. 족하괴청아언, 아역괴청족하지언, 습속연야. 연동득천소부지성, 칙아지성역요순공안지성, 기혐어어음지유이재?」기인무장왈: 「이분상, 가행주문공《가례》호?」신답왈: 「아국인수상개일준《가례》, 아당종지. 단위풍소역, 태금부득곡어구전, 소이통곡.」기인우문왈: 「이작시부?」신답왈: 「시사내경박자조롱풍월지자, 비학도독실군자소위야. 아이격치성정위학, 불용의학부시사야. 약혹유인선창, 부득불화이.」우유일인사신장상왈: 「간이야불시알인, 기이언어부동, 실동맹아, 성가연야. 아고이일언, 이기기지, 선자처, 신물경여인언. 자고왜적누겁아변경, 고국가설비왜도지휘, 비왜파총관이비지. 약획왜, 칙개선참후문. 금이초계주처, 할사자새지지, 수채관무여위왜, 욕헌괵도공, 고선보운: 『왜선십사척범변겁인』. 장영병왕포여참여지시, 이배선자사주투입인다지리, 고부득영기모의. 명일파총관래신이배. 이기상변지, 소유위오, 사재불측」운운. 신문기성명, 칙왈: 「아소이언지자, 애여야, 위지야!」도두이거. 신문기언, 모발수립, 즉어정보등.
paragraphs.en: A man named Wang Bi wrote to me: “Yesterday it was already reported to the higher authorities that fourteen Japanese ships violated the border and plundered people; are you indeed Japanese?” I said: “I am not Japanese; I am a literatus of the Kingdom of Joseon.” Another man named Lu Furong, calling himself a poor scholar, said to me: “Carts share the same gauge, writing the same script, yet only your speech differs from China’s; why?” I answered: “A thousand li, a different wind; a hundred li, a different custom. You find my speech strange to hear and I find yours strange to hear; it is custom that makes it so. But if we share the nature that Heaven endows, then my nature too is the nature of Yao, Shun, Confucius and Yan Hui; why should differences of speech trouble us?” The man clapped his hands and said: “You hastened to a funeral; can you practise Zhu Wengong’s Family Rites?” I answered: “The people of my country in keeping mourning all follow the Family Rites strictly; I too should follow them. But being blocked by the wind, to this day I have been unable to weep before the coffin, and that is why I weep so bitterly.” The man asked again: “Do you compose poetry?” I answered: “Poetry and verse are the resources of frivolous people for mocking wind and moon, and not what a sincere gentleman who studies the Way does. I take investigation of things, extension of knowledge, sincerity and rectification as my study, and do not set my mind on learning poetry and verse. But if someone starts first, I cannot but respond.” Another man wrote on my palm: “We see you are not a bad man; but because our speech is different you are really like a blind mute, truly pitiable. I tell you one thing; remember it, take good care of yourself, and be careful not to speak lightly to people. From of old Japanese pirates have repeatedly raided our border, so the state set up the Regional Commander for Defence against the Japanese and the Commander (bazong) for Defence against the Japanese to prepare against them. If Japanese are captured, they are all beheaded first and reported afterwards. Now the place where you first moored belongs to the area controlled by Shizi Fort; the fort-guarding official falsely accused you of being Japanese, wishing to present severed ears and seek merit, and so he reported first: ‘Fourteen Japanese ships have violated the border and plundered people.’ When he was about to lead troops to arrest you and behead you, you people had first left your boat and gone into a populous village, and so he could not carry out his plan. Tomorrow the Commander will come to interrogate you. You must explain in detail; the slightest error, and the matter is unfathomable,” and so on. I asked his name, and he said: “My reason for telling you is that I care for you, and I fear for you!” He shook his head and left. Hearing his words, my hair stood on end, and I told Jeong Bo and the others at once.

paragraphs.orig: 保等曰：「路人指我等為斬伐之狀者，皆惑此謀故耳。」日夕，千戶等官員十八人，置一大桌，環立桌邊，引程保於前，問曰：「你一起一十四隻船，實否？」保對曰：「否，但一隻而已。」揮程保以出。又引臣問曰：「你眾所駕原船幾隻？」臣曰：「衹一隻耳。」問曰：「我邊上瞭見倭船一十四隻同泊昨處海洋。我因守寨官之報，已報於上司大人，你船十三隻置之何地？」臣曰：「我之到海岸時，有貴地人等乘船六隻，同泊一海。若要究六船人，則我之船數可知矣。」問曰：「你以倭人登劫此處，何也？」臣曰：「我乃朝鮮人也。與倭語音有異，衣冠殊制，以此可辨。」問曰：「倭之神於為盜者，或有變服似若朝鮮人者，安知你非其倭乎？」臣曰：「觀我行止舉動，證我印牌、冠帶、文書，則可辨情偽。」千戶等即令臣拿印信等物來以質之。因問曰：「你無乃以倭劫朝鮮人得此物乎？」臣曰：「若少有疑我之心，姑令送我北京，與朝鮮通事員一話，情實立見。」問曰：「你姓何名誰？何州縣人？何職官？因何事幹到我邊境？開寫情狀，毋敢謊虛，我其申報上司。」臣曰：「姓崔名溥，住朝鮮國全羅道羅州城中。再登文科，筮仕朝著者有年。去丁未秋九月，奉國王命往濟州等處海島。今閏正月初三日，奔父喪顛倒還家，遭風漂海，得到於此。」曰：「你父名何？職何？死在何地？」臣曰：「父名澤，格進士試，以養親不仕。闋孝服僅四載，又死於羅州。」供畢後，館臣於別館，以供臣及從者。
paragraphs.reading: 보등왈: 「노인지아등위참벌지상자, 개혹차모고이.」일석, 천호등관원십팔인, 치일대탁, 환입탁변, 인정보어전, 문왈: 「이일기일십사척선, 실부?」보대왈: 「부, 단일척이이.」휘정보이출. 우인신문왈: 「이중소가원선기척?」신왈: 「기일척이.」문왈: 「아변상요견왜선일십사척동박작처해양. 아인수채관지보, 이보어상사대인, 이선십삼척치지하지?」신왈: 「아지도해안시, 유귀지인등승선육척, 동박일해. 약요구육선인, 칙아지선수가지의.」문왈: 「이이왜인등겁차처, 하야?」신왈: 「아내조선인야. 여왜어음유이, 의관수제, 이차가변.」문왈: 「왜지신어위도자, 혹유변복사약조선인자, 안지이비기왜호?」신왈: 「관아행지거동, 증아인패, 관대, 문서, 칙가변정위.」천호등즉영신나인신등물래이질지. 인문왈: 「이무내이왜겁조선인득차물호?」신왈: 「약소유의아지심, 고영송아북경, 여조선통사원일화, 정실입견.」문왈: 「이성하명수? 하주현인? 하직관? 인하사간도아변경? 개사정상, 무감황허, 아기신보상사.」신왈: 「성최명부, 주조선국전라도나주성중. 재등문과, 서사조저자유년. 거정미추구월, 봉국왕명왕제주등처해도. 금윤정월초삼일, 분부상전도환가, 조풍표해, 득도어차.」왈: 「이부명하? 직하? 사재하지?」신왈: 「부명택, 격진사시, 이양친불사. 결효복근사재, 우사어나주.」공필후, 관신어별관, 이공신급종자.
paragraphs.en: Bo and the others said: “The roadside people who pointed at us in the gesture of beheading were all deluded by this plot.” At dusk, eighteen officers including the Qianhu set up one big table, stood around the table, led Jeong Bo before them and asked: “Is it true that you came as one group of fourteen ships?” Bo replied: “No, only one ship.” They waved Jeong Bo out. They then led me forward and asked: “How many ships were you all in originally?” I said: “Only one.” They asked: “Our border scouts saw fourteen Japanese ships moored together in the sea at yesterday’s place. Because of the fort-guard’s report I have already reported to the higher authorities; where have you put the thirteen ships?” I said: “When I reached the sea coast, people of your region in six boats moored in the same sea. If you wish to investigate the people of the six boats, the number of my ships can be known.” They asked: “You came as Japanese to plunder this place; why?” I said: “I am a man of Joseon. My speech differs from the Japanese, and my clothes and caps are of a different system; by this one can tell.” They asked: “Among the Japanese, those clever at robbery may change their dress to resemble Joseon people; how do we know you are not such Japanese?” I said: “Look at my conduct and bearing, and verify my seal and tablet, cap and sash, and documents; then you can tell true from false.” The Qianhu at once ordered me to bring the seal and other items to be examined. And they asked: “Might you not have got these things by robbing Joseon people as Japanese?” I said: “If you have the slightest doubt of me, then send me to Beijing for the time being and let me have a talk with the Joseon interpreter; the truth will be seen at once.” They asked: “What is your surname and name? From what prefecture and county? What office do you hold? For what business did you come to our border? Write out the circumstances, with no falsehood, and I shall report to the higher authorities.” I said: “My surname is Choe, my name Bu; I live in the city of Naju, Jeolla Province, in the Kingdom of Joseon. I passed the literary examination twice and have for years held a post at court. Last year, in the autumn, the ninth month of the dingwei year, I was commanded by the king to go to the islands of Jeju and elsewhere. On the third day of this intercalary first month, hastening to my father’s funeral, I crossed in haste, met a storm and drifted on the sea, and have arrived here.” They asked: “What is your father’s name? What office? Where did he die?” I said: “My father’s name was Taek; he passed the licentiate examination, and did not take office, in order to care for his parents. He had barely finished his own period of mourning (for his parent) four years earlier when he died, at Naju.” After the deposition, they lodged me in a separate lodge and provided for me and my followers.

paragraphs.orig: 我國人為公為私往來濟州，或遭風無去處者，不可枚悉。終能生還者，十百僅一二。是豈盡沉於海波乎？其漂入島夷，若暹羅、占城之國者，無復望還，雖或漂至中國之界，亦為邊人所誤，誣以倭賊，折馘受賞，則誰能辨其情乎？如臣等者，若不先自下陸，若無印牌之信，豈復免於禍哉？我國家若依中朝制，凡百官給號牌、錫牌，篆書職、姓名，以旌異之。奉使臣，無大小，給節鉞，以尊王命。抑又沿海住人，雖以私商過海者，皆給號牌，書某國、某州縣、某姓名、某形、某年甲，以別之。又置通事一員於濟州，凡奉使臣及三邑守令往還，常川帶行，以圖後慮，然後庶可免於患。
paragraphs.reading: 아국인위공위사왕래제주, 혹조풍무거처자, 불가매실. 종능생환자, 십백근일이. 시기진침어해파호? 기표입도이, 약섬라, 점성지국자, 무부망환, 수혹표지중국지계, 역위변인소오, 무이왜적, 절괵수상, 칙수능변기정호? 여신등자, 약불선자하륙, 약무인패지신, 기부면어화재? 아국가약의중조제, 범백관급호패, 석패, 전서직, 성명, 이정이지. 봉사신, 무대소, 급절월, 이존왕명. 억우연해주인, 수이사상과해자, 개급호패, 서모국, 모주현, 모성명, 모형, 모년갑, 이별지. 우치통사일원어제주, 범봉사신급삼읍수령왕환, 상천대행, 이도후려, 연후서가면어환.
paragraphs.en: Our countrymen who go to and from Jeju on public or private business, and meet storms and have nowhere to go, cannot all be counted. Of those who finally returned alive, only one or two in ten or a hundred. Can they all have sunk in the waves? Those who drifted to the barbarians of the islands, such as the countries of Siam and Champa, have no hope of return; and even if they drift into the Chinese border, they are misled by border people who falsely accuse them as Japanese pirates, cut off their ears and receive rewards, and then who can sort out their circumstances? As for people like us, had we not first gone ashore of our own accord, had we not the credential of seal and tablet, how would we have avoided disaster? If our state were to follow the Central Dynasty’s system, giving all officials number tablets and bestowed tablets inscribed in seal script with office, surname and name, to distinguish them; and giving envoys, large and small, the tally and axe, to honour the king’s command; and moreover to coastal residents, even those crossing the sea on private trade, giving all number tablets inscribed with their country, prefecture and county, surname and name, appearance, and year of birth, to tell them apart; and further placing one interpreter in Jeju, who would always accompany envoys and the magistrates of the three districts when they come and go, to provide for later concerns — then perhaps we could avoid the trouble.

paragraphs.orig: ## △二十日
paragraphs.en: 20th day

paragraphs.orig: 在桃渚所。是日乍陰乍晴。臣問桃渚所千戶姓名，則乃陳華也。華與一官人來看臣，指臣笠曰：「此何帽子？」臣曰：「此喪笠也。國俗皆廬墓三年。不幸如我漂流，或不得已有遠行者，則不敢仰見天日，以堅泣血之心，所以有此深笠也。」及至飯時，許清引臣同桌坐。有一人以箸畫桌上曰：「你吃豬肉否？」臣曰：「我國人守喪，三年不食魚肉醢葷。」其人以別器盛素饌以饋臣。許清又見臣之衣服沾濕未乾，謂臣曰：「今日有陽，可脫衣以曬之。」臣答曰：「我衣皆濕，脫此則無可穿者，不能曬也。」許清引臣坐諸面陽之地，以令曬乾。有一官人來問曰：「你國王稱皇帝否？」臣答曰：「天無二日，安有一天之下有二皇帝乎？我王心誠事大而已。」又問曰：「你國官人果皆犀帶乎？」曰：「一、二品著金，三、四品著銀，五、六品以下皆著烏角，而無犀帶。」又問曰：「你國有金銀否？」曰：「金銀非本國所產。」曰：「然則何以有金銀帶？」曰：「皆來貿上國，所以貴也。」臣問其官人為何人，其人即出公文以示，則乃把總官先差此官人——給牌星馳前去挑渚所獲住臣等，按臨重解，毋得違誤者，——姓名即薛旻也。又有一人來曰：「我寧波府定海衛人，因此處都司公差到此。」臣即問曰：「寧波府有下山否？」曰：「有之。」臣因言前日到泊下山逢海賊復漂流之故。其人曰：「我當持此文字告知府往問之。」臣問其姓名，則王海也。又有外人群聚而至，爭持紙筆以問，不可勝對。有官人密書以示曰：「此處人輕薄，休與閑講！」
paragraphs.reading: 재도저소. 시일사음사청. 신문도저소천호성명, 칙내진화야. 화여일관인래간신, 지신립왈: 「차하모자?」신왈: 「차상립야. 국속개여묘삼년. 불행여아표류, 혹부득이유원행자, 칙불감앙견천일, 이견읍혈지심, 소이유차심립야.」급지반시, 허청인신동탁좌. 유일인이저획탁상왈: 「이흘저육부?」신왈: 「아국인수상, 삼년불식어육해훈.」기인이별기성소찬이궤신. 허청우견신지의복첨습미건, 위신왈: 「금일유양, 가탈의이쇄지.」신답왈: 「아의개습, 탈차칙무가천자, 불능쇄야.」허청인신좌제면양지지, 이영쇄건. 유일관인래문왈: 「이국왕칭황제부?」신답왈: 「천무이일, 안유일천지하유이황제호? 아왕심성사대이이.」우문왈: 「이국관인과개서대호?」왈: 「일, 이품착금, 삼, 사품착은, 오, 육품이하개착오각, 이무서대.」우문왈: 「이국유금은부?」왈: 「금은비본국소산.」왈: 「연칙하이유금은대?」왈: 「개래무상국, 소이귀야.」신문기관인위하인, 기인즉출공문이시, 칙내파총관선차차관인——급패성치전거도저소획주신등, 안임중해, 무득위오자, ——성명즉설민야. 우유일인래왈: 「아영파부정해위인, 인차처도사공차도차.」신즉문왈: 「영파부유하산부?」왈: 「유지.」신인언전일도박하산봉해적부표류지고. 기인왈: 「아당지차문자고지부왕문지.」신문기성명, 칙왕해야. 우유외인군취이지, 쟁지지필이문, 불가승대. 유관인밀서이시왈: 「차처인경박, 휴여한강!」
paragraphs.en: At Taozhu Garrison. That day alternately overcast and fair. I asked the name of the Qianhu of Taozhu Garrison, and it was Chen Hua. Hua and another official came to see me, and pointing at my hat asked: “What kind of hat is that?” I said: “This is a mourning hat. By the custom of our country all keep a hut by the grave for three years. If one unfortunately drifts like me, or is forced to go on a long journey, one does not dare look up at the sun and sky, in order to hold fast the heart that weeps blood; that is why there is this deep hat.” When mealtime came, Xu Qing led me to sit at the same table. A man drew on the table with chopsticks and said: “Do you eat pork?” I said: “Our people in mourning for three years do not eat fish, meat, pickles or pungent vegetables.” The man put plain dishes in another vessel and gave them to me. Xu Qing, seeing that my clothes were wet and not yet dry, said to me: “Today there is sun; take off your clothes and dry them.” I answered: “My clothes are all wet; if I take these off there is nothing to wear, so I cannot dry them.” Xu Qing led me to sit in a sunny place so that they might dry. An official came and asked: “Does your king call himself emperor?” I answered: “Heaven does not have two suns; how can there be two emperors under one heaven? My king’s heart is simply sincere in serving the great.” He asked again: “Do all the officials of your country wear rhinoceros belts?” “Those of the first and second rank wear gold, third and fourth wear silver, fifth and sixth and below all wear black horn, and there are no rhinoceros belts.” He asked again: “Does your country have gold and silver?” “Gold and silver are not products of our country.” “Then why are there gold and silver belts?” “They are all bought from the Superior Country, which is why they are precious.” I asked who this official was, and the man produced an official document to show me: he was the official first dispatched by the Commander (bazong) — given a tablet, to gallop ahead to Taozhu, seize and hold us, and bring us for review and escort, without fail — and his surname and name was Xue Min. Another man came and said: “I am a man of Dinghai Guard in Ningbo Prefecture, here on official business on behalf of the Regional Military Commission of this place.” I at once asked: “Does Ningbo Prefecture have a Xiashan?” “It does.” I then told of how I had moored at Xiashan the other day, met sea-robbers, and drifted again. The man said: “I shall take this document and tell the prefect, and ask about it.” I asked his name, and it was Wang Hai. Outsiders also gathered in groups, vying to hold paper and brush to ask me questions, more than I could answer. An official secretly wrote and showed me: “People here are frivolous; do not chat idly with them!”

paragraphs.orig: ## △二十一日
paragraphs.en: 21st day

paragraphs.orig: 在桃渚所。是日晴。外人麋至觀臣。王海指壁上一真像曰：「你知此畫乎否？」曰：「不曉得。」海曰：「此乃唐朝進士鍾馗也。」臣曰：「鍾馗平生不得進士，何以謂之進士？」海等喧噪大笑。又有白髮老翁來。臣問曰：「天台、雁蕩等山距此地幾里？」翁答曰：「天台山在天台縣北，距此二日程。天台山之南，一日程，有雁蕩山。」臣又問：「此城主山何？」曰：「石柱山也。」引臣出門，指點石柱山，則果石壁作山，當山頂有大石如柱形。臣曰：「自此距北京幾里？」翁曰：「五千八百有餘里。」問：「距揚子大江幾里？」翁曰：「在北二千有餘里。」臣又舉李暹所泊揚帥府以問曰：「距此幾里？」翁曰：「在揚子江之北。你去，過江則便是揚州之境也。」又問：「距南京幾里？」翁曰：「在西北二千餘里，然皆臆料耳，未敢的知」云云。有大官人，前嗬後擁，軍儀整肅而至，坐於皇華館。問之，則乃把總松門等處備倭指揮劉澤也。
paragraphs.reading: 재도저소. 시일청. 외인미지관신. 왕해지벽상일진상왈: 「이지차화호부?」왈: 「불효득.」해왈: 「차내당조진사종규야.」신왈: 「종규평생부득진사, 하이위지진사?」해등훤조대소. 우유백발노옹래. 신문왈: 「천태, 안탕등산거차지기리?」옹답왈: 「천태산재천태현북, 거차이일정. 천태산지남, 일일정, 유안탕산.」신우문: 「차성주산하?」왈: 「석주산야.」인신출문, 지점석주산, 칙과석벽작산, 당산정유대석여주형. 신왈: 「자차거북경기리?」옹왈: 「오천팔백유여리.」문: 「거양자대강기리?」옹왈: 「재북이천유여리.」신우거이섬소박양수부이문왈: 「거차기리?」옹왈: 「재양자강지북. 이거, 과강칙편시양주지경야.」우문: 「거남경기리?」옹왈: 「재서북이천여리, 연개억료이, 미감적지」운운. 유대관인, 전하후옹, 군의정숙이지, 좌어황화관. 문지, 칙내파총송문등처비왜지휘유택야.
paragraphs.en: At Taozhu Garrison. That day fair. Outsiders came in crowds to see me. Wang Hai pointed to a portrait on the wall and said: “Do you know this picture or not?” “I don’t know.” Hai said: “This is Zhong Kui, a jinshi of the Tang dynasty.” I said: “Zhong Kui never got the jinshi degree in his whole life; why call him a jinshi?” Hai and the others laughed loudly in uproar. An old white-haired man also came. I asked: “How many li from here are Mt. Tiantai and Mt. Yandang?” The old man answered: “Mt. Tiantai is north of Tiantai County, two days’ journey from here. South of Mt. Tiantai, a day’s journey, is Mt. Yandang.” I asked again: “What is this town’s guardian mountain?” “Mt. Shizhu (Stone Pillar).” He led me out of the gate and pointed out Mt. Shizhu, which indeed was a rock cliff forming a mountain, with a great stone at the summit in the shape of a pillar. I said: “How many li from here to Beijing?” The old man said: “More than five thousand eight hundred li.” I asked: “How many li to the great Yangzi River?” The old man said: “It is over two thousand li to the north.” I further brought up the Yangshuai headquarters where Yi Seom had moored, and asked: “How many li is it from here?” The old man said: “It is north of the Yangzi River. If you go, crossing the river brings you at once to the Yangzhou border.” I asked again: “How many li to Nanjing?” The old man said: “More than two thousand li to the north-west, but all this is guesswork, I dare not say for sure,” and so on. A great official, with criers before and attendants behind, in orderly military array, arrived and sat in the Huanghua Hall. Asked, he was Liu Ze, Commander for Defence against the Japanese at Songmen and other places, the bazong.

paragraphs.orig: 招臣等來前曰：「以汝類私越邊境，本當處以軍法，恐其中情有可矜，姑未盡戳。有無侵犯上國情狀，從實供寫施行。」臣供曰：「姓崔名溥；居朝鮮國全羅道羅州城中。再登文科，為國王近臣。去丁未九月十七日，奉王命為濟州等處敬差官。濟州在南海中，距羅州水路千餘里。同年十一月十二日，渡海推刷人丁，事未竣。今戊申正月三十日，聞父喪。閏正月初三日，不候風便顛倒過海，為風所逆，驚濤掀浪，載沉載傾，饑食渴水，十生九死。以今月十二日，到泊名不知海島，有漁船來問曰：『你是何國人？』答以朝鮮國人漂流之故。因問：『此何國地面？』其人答曰：『此大唐國寧波府下山』云云。其夜有賊船二十餘人來，以斫刀恐嚇欲斬，攘奪衣、糧、行裝等物，遂截去櫓碇而去，復漂流大洋。十七日，又到泊地名不知海岸，又有漁船六隻列立。恐其如前所遇海賊之類，舍舟緣陸，過二嶺六七里許，有人居。相次遞送，夜至仙岩里。其里人爭以隅杖亂擊劫奪。遞至一處，遇有官人，驅至於此城。」又問曰：「你登第何年？歷仕幾官？所帶人住何州縣地？行李有何器械？原有船幾隻？」臣曰：「我於成化丁酉格進士試第三人；壬寅中文科乙科第一人，為校書館著作，為博士，為軍資監主簿，為成均館典籍，為司憲府監察，為弘文館副修撰，為修撰；丙午中文科重試乙科第一人，為弘文館副校理，為龍驤衛司果，為副司直。所帶人：陪吏四人——光州牧吏程保、和順縣吏金重、羅州牧吏孫孝子、濟州牧吏李孝枝；伴率一人李楨，京都人；鎮撫一人安義，濟州人；驛吏一人崔巨伊山，羅州青岩驛人；奴子莫金等二人、濟州官奴權松等四人、護送軍金粟等九人、船格軍許尚理等二十人，皆濟州人。所乘船隻一大隻，檣帆桅楫遭風而失，碇櫓遇賊而失。所齎之物：印信一顆、馬牌一隻、紗帽、角帶、所治文書、重試榜錄、書冊、弓一張、刀一把及各人所穿衣裳外，無他器械。」把總官即點印信等物。
paragraphs.reading: 초신등래전왈: 「이여류사월변경, 본당처이군법, 공기중정유가긍, 고미진착. 유무침범상국정상, 종실공사시행.」신공왈: 「성최명부; 거조선국전라도나주성중. 재등문과, 위국왕근신. 거정미구월십칠일, 봉왕명위제주등처경차관. 제주재남해중, 거나주수로천여리. 동년십일월십이일, 도해추쇄인정, 사미준. 금무신정월삼십일, 문부상. 윤정월초삼일, 불후풍편전도과해, 위풍소역, 경도흔랑, 재침재경, 기식갈수, 십생구사. 이금월십이일, 도박명부지해도, 유어선래문왈: 『이시하국인? 』답이조선국인표류지고. 인문: 『차하국지면? 』기인답왈: 『차대당국영파부하산』운운. 기야유적선이십여인래, 이작도공하욕참, 양탈의, 양, 행장등물, 수절거로정이거, 부표류대양. 십칠일, 우도박지명부지해안, 우유어선육척열립. 공기여전소우해적지류, 사주연륙, 과이령육칠리허, 유인거. 상차체송, 야지선암리. 기이인쟁이우장난격겁탈. 체지일처, 우유관인, 구지어차성.」우문왈: 「이등제하년? 역사기관? 소대인주하주현지? 행리유하기계? 원유선기척?」신왈: 「아어성화정유격진사시제삼인; 임인중문과을과제일인, 위교서관저작, 위박사, 위군자감주부, 위성균관전적, 위사헌부감찰, 위홍문관부수찬, 위수찬; 병오중문과중시을과제일인, 위홍문관부교리, 위룡양위사과, 위부사직. 소대인: 배리사인——광주목리정보, 화순현리김중, 나주목리손효자, 제주목리이효지; 반솔일인이정, 경도인; 진무일인안의, 제주인; 역리일인최거이산, 나주청암역인; 노자막금등이인, 제주관노권송등사인, 호송군김속등구인, 선격군허상리등이십인, 개제주인. 소승선척일대척, 장범외즙조풍이실, 정로우적이실. 소재지물: 인신일과, 마패일척, 사모, 각대, 소치문서, 중시방록, 서책, 궁일장, 도일파급각인소천의상외, 무타기계.」파총관즉점인신등물.
paragraphs.en: He summoned us forward and said: “Your kind, privately crossing the border, should properly be dealt with by military law, but fearing there may be circumstances worthy of pity, I have for now not put you all to death. Whether or not there has been any encroachment against the Superior Country, write down a true statement for implementation.” I made my statement: “My surname is Choe, my name Bu; I live in the city of Naju, Jeolla Province, in the Kingdom of Joseon. I passed the literary examination twice and am a close subject of the king. On the seventeenth day of the ninth month of the past dingwei year, I was commanded by the king to be Special Commissioner for Jeju and elsewhere. Jeju lies in the southern sea, more than a thousand li by water from Naju. On the twelfth day of the eleventh month of the same year I crossed the sea to investigate and register the people; the task was not finished. This year, the wushen year, on the thirtieth day of the first month, I heard of my father’s death. On the third day of the intercalary first month, without waiting for a favourable wind, I crossed the sea in haste; opposed by the wind, with startling breakers and heaving waves, now sinking, now tilting, eating hunger and drinking thirst, it was ten lives and nine deaths. On the twelfth of this month I anchored at an island of unknown name, where a fishing boat came and asked: ‘What country are you from?’ I told them of being a Joseon person adrift. I then asked: ‘What country is this land?’ The man answered: ‘This is Xiashan in Ningbo Prefecture of the Great Tang,’ and so on. That night a robber boat with twenty or more men came, and threatened to behead us with cutlasses, seized clothes, provisions, baggage and the like, and then cut away our sculls and anchor and left; and we drifted again in the great ocean. On the seventeenth we again anchored at a coast of unknown name, where six fishing boats again stood in a row. Fearing they were of the kind of the sea-robbers met before, I left the boat and went along the land, crossing two ridges for six or seven li, where there were dwellings. We were sent on in relays, and at night reached Xianyan village. The villagers vied in striking and plundering us wildly with corner-clubs. Passed on to one place, we met an official, who drove us to this town.” He asked further: “In what year did you pass the examination? How many offices have you held? In which prefectures and counties do your attendants live? What weapons are there in your baggage? How many ships were there originally?” I said: “In the Dingyou year of Chenghua I passed the jinsa examination in third place; in the renyin year I passed the literary examination, first in the second class; I became an Author (jeojak) at the Gyoseogwan (Office of Collation), then a Doctor (baksa), then a Registrar (jubu) of the Gunjagam (Office of Military Provisions), then an Archivist (jeonjeok) of the Seonggyungwan, then an Inspector (gamchal) of the Saheonbu (Office of the Inspector-General), then an Assistant Compiler (bu-sujan) of the Hongmungwan, and then a Compiler (sujan). In the bingwu year I passed the re-examination, first in the second class, and became an Assistant Fellow (bu-gyori) of the Hongmungwan, a Captain (sagwa) of the Yongyang Guard, and an Assistant Court Official (busajik). My attendants: four attendant clerks — Jeong Bo, a clerk of Gwangju Prefecture; Kim Jung, a clerk of Hwasun County; Son Hyoja, a clerk of Naju Prefecture; and Yi Hyoji, a clerk of Jeju Prefecture; one companion, Yi Jeong, a man of the capital; one pacification officer, An Ui, a man of Jeju; one station clerk, Choe Geoisan, of Cheongam Station in Naju; two slaves, Makgeum and another; four government slaves of Jeju, Gwon Song and others; nine escort soldiers, Kim Sok and others; and twenty ship’s crew soldiers, Heo Sangni and others, all people of Jeju. The vessel was one large ship; mast, sail, rudder and oars were lost in the storm, and anchor and sculls lost to robbers. The things I carried: one seal, one horse-tablet, a gauze cap, a horn belt, the documents I had handled, the record of the re-examination list, books, one bow, one knife, and apart from the clothes each person wore, no other weapons.” The Commander at once checked the seal and other things.

paragraphs.orig: 又問曰：「汝國地方遠近幾何？府州幾何？兵糧約有幾何？本地所產何物為貴？所讀詩書尊崇何典？衣冠禮樂從何代之制？一一寫述，以憑查考。」臣曰：「本國地方則無慮數千餘里；有八道，所屬州府郡縣總三百有餘；所產則人材、五穀、馬牛雞犬；所讀而尊崇者，四書五經；衣冠禮樂則一遵華制；兵糧則我以儒臣未曾經諳，未詳其數。」又問曰：「汝國與日本、琉球、高麗相通乎？」臣曰：「日本、琉球俱在東南大海中，相距隔遠，未相通信。高麗革為今我朝鮮。」又問曰：「汝國亦朝貢我朝廷否？」臣曰：「我國每歲如聖節、正朝貢獻愈謹。」又問曰：「汝國用何法度？別有年號乎？」臣曰：「年號、法度一遵大明。」把總官問畢，因曰：「汝邦屢歲朝貢，義有君臣之好，既無侵逆之情，當遇以禮。各宜安心，勿生他慮。轉送赴京，遣還本土。急促行裝，不許稽緩。」即饋以茶果。臣即做謝詩以拜。把總官曰：「不要拜！」臣不知所言，敢拜之。把總官亦起，相對答禮。
paragraphs.reading: 우문왈: 「여국지방원근기하? 부주기하? 병량약유기하? 본지소산하물위귀? 소독시서존숭하전? 의관예악종하대지제? 일일사술, 이빙사고.」신왈: 「본국지방칙무려수천여리; 유팔도, 소속주부군현총삼백유여; 소산칙인재, 오곡, 마우계견; 소독이존숭자, 사서오경; 의관예악칙일준화제; 병량칙아이유신미증경암, 미상기수.」우문왈: 「여국여일본, 유구, 고려상통호?」신왈: 「일본, 유구구재동남대해중, 상거격원, 미상통신. 고려혁위금아조선.」우문왈: 「여국역조공아조정부?」신왈: 「아국매세여성절, 정조공헌유근.」우문왈: 「여국용하법도? 별유년호호?」신왈: 「연호, 법도일준대명.」파총관문필, 인왈: 「여방누세조공, 의유군신지호, 기무침역지정, 당우이례. 각의안심, 물생타려. 전송부경, 견환본토. 급촉행장, 불허계완.」즉궤이다과. 신즉주사시이배. 파총관왈: 「불요배!」신부지소언, 감배지. 파총관역기, 상대답례.
paragraphs.en: He asked further: “How far in extent is your country’s territory? How many prefectures and districts? About how much military provision? What local products are valued? What classics do your books esteem? From which dynasty’s system are your dress, ritual and music? Write it all out, one by one, for verification.” I said: “The extent of our country’s territory is no fewer than several thousand li; there are eight provinces, with over three hundred prefectures, districts, commanderies and counties in all; the products are talented men, the five grains, horses, cattle, fowl and dogs; what we read and esteem are the Four Books and the Five Classics; dress, ritual and music all follow the Chinese system; as for military provisions, as a Confucian official I have never been involved with them and do not know the numbers.” He asked again: “Does your country communicate with Japan, Ryukyu and Goryeo?” I said: “Japan and Ryukyu are both in the great sea to the south-east, far separated, and have no communication with us. Goryeo was changed into our present Joseon.” He asked again: “Does your country also pay tribute to our court?” I said: “Our country each year, as at the Imperial Birthday and the New Year, presents tribute ever more carefully.” He asked again: “What laws does your country use? Do you have a separate reign-name?” I said: “Reign-name and laws all follow the Great Ming.” When the Commander had finished his questions, he said: “Your country pays tribute year after year, there is a bond of ruler and subject in righteousness, and as you have no intent of invasion you should be treated with courtesy. Each of you may set your mind at ease and not harbour other worries. You will be sent on to the capital and returned to your own land. Pack your baggage quickly; delay is not permitted.” He then treated us to tea and fruit. I composed a poem of thanks on the spot and bowed. The Commander said: “No need to bow!” I did not understand what he said and dared to bow. The Commander too rose, and returned the courtesy face to face.

paragraphs.orig: ## △二十二日
paragraphs.en: 22nd day

paragraphs.orig: 在桃渚所。是日陰。把總官又引臣於前，將昨日招詞刪削下山遇賊、仙岩毆擊等事及文繁處，令臣更寫一幅。薛旻立桌邊，謂臣曰：「此文字報上司，以達於皇帝，文宜簡略，故我老爹刪繁就簡，令你改寫，你勿疑也。」臣不肯寫，曰：「供詞當以直文，雖繁何害也？且所刪者，乃遇賊之事，卻添一言曰：『軍人衣服俱有』云云。沒我遇賊情實，抑何意歟？」薛旻密寫示曰：「今皇帝新即位，法令嚴肅，若見你前所供詞，帝意必謂盜賊盛行，歸罪邊將非細事也。為你計，當以生返本國為心，不宜好為生事也。」臣聞其言以為然，即舉筆隨所刪寫之。薛旻又謂臣曰：「你既為軍資監主簿，何以曰不知兵糧之數？」臣曰：「我為軍資監未滿月見遞，故未詳其數。」又問曰：「你浮海上不食幾日？」臣曰：「自初三日至十一日。」曰：「然則何不至於餓死？」臣曰：「間或嚼乾米，飲尿。溲尿又盡，待天雨漬衣汁，飲以續一髮之命，不死幸耳。」又問曰：「你年齒幾何？」臣曰：「三十有五歲。」又問：「你辭家幾日？」臣曰：「月已六度圓矣。」曰：「你思家山否？」臣曰：「父已云亡，慈母在堂，哭之已變國俗，又以我為溺死，益篤傷痛之心。我今生到異邦，念及至此，無日不痛哭。」曰：「為人臣者，國爾忘家，你因王事漂到於此，當移孝為忠，何憶家為？」臣曰：「求忠臣於孝子之門，未有不盡孝於親而忠於君者。況風樹不止，日迫西山，安得而不思吾亡父與慈母乎？」又問曰：「你國王姓諱何？」臣曰：「孝子不忍舉父母之名，故聞人過失如聞父母之名，況為臣子其可以國君之諱輕與人說乎？」曰：「越界無妨。」臣曰：「我不是朝鮮之臣乎？為人臣者，其可以越界而負其國，異其行，變其言乎？我則不如是也。」薛旻即將與臣問答之詞呈於把總官。把總官或讀或點頭，顧謂臣曰：「明日差官送你起程。凡有隨身行李依件寫來，免致前路失所。」臣退舍館。有王匡者——許清之鷹犬也——或嚇或誘，誅求無厭。臣之行李無物，無以應之。至是又來言曰：「我每大人之恩不可不報！」臣解所著襺帖裏，以與許清之子隆。
paragraphs.reading: 재도저소. 시일음. 파총관우인신어전, 장작일초사산삭하산우적, 선암구격등사급문번처, 영신갱사일폭. 설민입탁변, 위신왈: 「차문자보상사, 이달어황제, 문의간략, 고아노다산번취간, 영이개사, 이물의야.」신불긍사, 왈: 「공사당이직문, 수번하해야? 차소산자, 내우적지사, 각첨일언왈: 『군인의복구유』운운. 몰아우적정실, 억하의여?」설민밀사시왈: 「금황제신즉위, 법령엄숙, 약견이전소공사, 제의필위도적성행, 귀죄변장비세사야. 위이계, 당이생반본국위심, 불의호위생사야.」신문기언이위연, 즉거필수소산사지. 설민우위신왈: 「이기위군자감주부, 하이왈부지병량지수?」신왈: 「아위군자감미만월견체, 고미상기수.」우문왈: 「이부해상불식기일?」신왈: 「자초삼일지십일일.」왈: 「연칙하부지어아사?」신왈: 「간혹작건미, 음뇨. 수뇨우진, 대천우지의즙, 음이속일발지명, 불사행이.」우문왈: 「이년치기하?」신왈: 「삼십유오세.」우문: 「이사가기일?」신왈: 「월이육도원의.」왈: 「이사가산부?」신왈: 「부이운망, 자모재당, 곡지이변국속, 우이아위익사, 익독상통지심. 아금생도이방, 염급지차, 무일불통곡.」왈: 「위인신자, 국이망가, 이인왕사표도어차, 당이효위충, 하억가위?」신왈: 「구충신어효자지문, 미유부진효어친이충어군자. 황풍수부지, 일박서산, 안득이불사오망부여자모호?」우문왈: 「이국왕성휘하?」신왈: 「효자불인거부모지명, 고문인과실여문부모지명, 황위신자기가이국군지휘경여인설호?」왈: 「월계무방.」신왈: 「아불시조선지신호? 위인신자, 기가이월계이부기국, 이기행, 변기언호? 아칙불여시야.」설민즉장여신문답지사정어파총관. 파총관혹독혹점두, 고위신왈: 「명일차관송이기정. 범유수신행리의건사래, 면치전로실소.」신퇴사관. 유왕광자——허청지응견야——혹하혹유, 주구무염. 신지행리무물, 무이응지. 지시우래언왈: 「아매대인지은불가불보!」신해소착견첩리, 이여허청지자륭.
paragraphs.en: At Taozhu Garrison. That day overcast. The Commander again led me before him and, having struck from yesterday’s deposition the matters of meeting robbers at Xiashan, the beating at Xianyan and the verbose passages, had me write another sheet. Xue Min stood beside the table and said to me: “This document is to be reported to the higher authorities and reach the Emperor; the writing should be brief, so my old master cut the wordy to make it concise and ordered you to rewrite it; do not doubt.” I would not write it, and said: “A deposition should be in straight words; even if wordy, what harm? Moreover what has been struck is the matter of meeting robbers, and in its place a sentence has been added: ‘the soldiers have clothing and all.’ This erases the true circumstances of my meeting robbers; what is the meaning?” Xue Min secretly wrote and showed me: “The present Emperor has newly acceded; laws and orders are strict. If he saw the deposition you made before, His Majesty would surely think robbers are rampant, and to put blame on the border commanders is no small matter. For your own sake, you should have it in mind to return alive to your own country, and not love making trouble.” Hearing his words, I thought them right, and at once took up the brush and wrote, following what had been struck. Xue Min further said to me: “Since you were registrar of the Office of Military Provisions, why do you say you do not know the numbers of the military provisions?” I said: “I was in the Gunjagam less than a month before I was replaced, so I do not know the numbers in detail.” He asked again: “How many days were you on the sea without eating?” I said: “From the third day to the eleventh.” “Then how did you not die of starvation?” I said: “Occasionally I chewed dry rice and drank urine. When the urine ran out too, I waited for the rain to wet my clothes and drank the juice, to continue life by a hair’s breadth; that I did not die was luck.” He asked again: “How old are you?” I said: “Thirty-five.” He asked: “How many days since you left home?” I said: “The moon has already been round six times.” He said: “Do you think of your home hills?” I said: “My father is already dead and my kind mother is in the hall; weeping has already changed the custom of the country, and since she thinks I have drowned, her grief is deepened. Now, born alive in a foreign land, thinking of this, there is not a day I do not weep bitterly.” He said: “For a subject to forget his house for the sake of his country — you drifted here on royal business and ought to transfer your filial piety to loyalty; why remember home?” I said: “Seek loyal ministers at the gate of the filial son; there has never been one who was not filial to his parents and loyal to his ruler. Moreover, the tree wants to be still but the wind will not stop, and the sun nears the western hill; how could I not think of my dead father and my kind mother?” He asked again: “What are your king’s surname and personal name?” I said: “A filial son cannot bear to cite the names of his parents, so that hearing of others’ faults is to him like hearing his parents’ names; how much more should a subject and son lightly tell others the name of his sovereign?” He said: “Crossing the border is no harm.” I said: “Am I not a subject of Joseon? Can one who is a subject cross the border and betray his country, change his conduct, alter his words? I will not do so.” Xue Min then took the record of his questions and my answers and presented it to the Commander. The Commander read some and nodded at some, and, turning, said to me: “Tomorrow an officer will be sent to see you off on your way. Write down all the baggage you have with you, item by item, to avoid losing things on the road ahead.” I withdrew to my lodging. There was one Wang Kuang — Xu Qing’s hawk and hound — who now threatened, now lured, extorting without limit. I had nothing in my baggage with which to answer him. At this he came again and said: “We cannot fail to repay the kindness of the great gentlemen!” I took off the quilted lined robe I was wearing and gave it to Xu Qing’s son, Long.

paragraphs.orig: 台州，古東甌國之地，在閩之東，越之南。而牛頭外洋等處，轄臨海縣地，又在台外州東南絕徼，風氣溫暖，恒雨少日，實炎荒瘴癘之方。臣當正月而到，氣候與三四月同，牟麥欲穗，筍芽方盛，桃杏滿開。又山川高大，林藪屏翳，人物繁夥，第宅壯麗，別是一區天地也。
paragraphs.reading: 태주, 고동구국지지, 재민지동, 월지남. 이우두외양등처, 할임해현지, 우재태외주동남절요, 풍기온난, 항우소일, 실염황장려지방. 신당정월이도, 기후여삼사월동, 모맥욕수, 순아방성, 도행만개. 우산천고대, 임수병예, 인물번과, 제택장려, 별시일구천지야.
paragraphs.en: Taizhou is the land of the ancient Eastern Ou kingdom, east of Min and south of Yue. The Niutou outer sea and other such places fall under Linhai County, and lie moreover beyond Taizhou at the remotest south-eastern frontier, a place whose climate is warm, rainy and seldom sunny — truly a sultry, malarial region of the south. I arrived in the first month, yet the weather was the same as in the third or fourth month: the barley was about to ear, the bamboo shoots were just flourishing, and peach and apricot blossoms were in full bloom. Moreover the mountains and rivers were high and great, the woods thick and screening, the people numerous, the houses grand; it was truly another realm of heaven and earth.

paragraphs.orig: ## △二十三日
paragraphs.en: 23rd day

paragraphs.orig: 自桃渚所登程。是日陰。把總官又引臣及從者於前，令臣叫姓名點數。差千戶翟勇及軍吏二十餘人，護送臣等於總兵官。臣及陪吏等俱乘轎以行。梁達海——奸狡者——托病扶杖似不能步，把總官亦許轎。乘轎者凡八人，翟勇、許清、王匡等與臣等。過山場、鳥頭二嶺，間有三大川，鳥頭嶺下又有鑒溪。許清邀臣等於溪邊人家做飯以饋。又行過塘頭、蒲峰等地。犯夜，至一道旁佛宇而宿。其前里閈即仙岩里。自桃渚所至此，乃臣前此被驅所經之路也。夜，許清、翟勇鞫其里長，捕其奪馬鞍者，報於官，還馬鞍於臣。軍人所見奪笠子、網巾等物俱不得。
paragraphs.reading: 자도저소등정. 시일음. 파총관우인신급종자어전, 영신규성명점수. 차천호적용급군리이십여인, 호송신등어총병관. 신급배리등구승교이행. 양달해——간교자——탁병부장사불능보, 파총관역허교. 승교자범팔인, 적용, 허청, 왕광등여신등. 과산장, 조두이령, 간유삼대천, 조두령하우유감계. 허청요신등어계변인가주반이궤. 우행과당두, 포봉등지. 범야, 지일도방불우이숙. 기전이한즉선암리. 자도저소지차, 내신전차피구소경지로야. 야, 허청, 적용국기이장, 포기탈마안자, 보어관, 환마안어신. 군인소견탈입자, 망건등물구부득.
paragraphs.en: Set out from Taozhu Garrison. That day overcast. The Commander again led me and my followers before him and had me call out our names for a count. He assigned Qianhu Zhai Yong and twenty or more military clerks to escort us to the Commander-in-Chief. I and the attendant clerks all travelled by sedan chair. Yang Dalhae — a cunning man — feigned illness and leaned on a staff as though unable to walk, and the Commander also allowed him a chair. Those riding in chairs numbered eight in all: Zhai Yong, Xu Qing, Wang Kuang and the others, with us. We crossed the two ridges of Shanchang and Niaotou; in between there were three large rivers, and at the foot of Niaotou Ridge there was also the Jian Stream. Xu Qing invited us to a house by the stream to cook rice for us to eat. We went on past Tangtou, Pufeng and other places. After the curfew we reached a Buddhist temple by the roadside and lodged there. The village in front of it was Xianyan village. The way from Taozhu Garrison to here was the road by which I had been driven before. At night Xu Qing and Zhai Yong interrogated the village head, seized the man who had taken the saddle, reported him to the authorities, and had the saddle returned to me. The soldiers’ hats, hair-nets and other things that had been taken were all not recovered.

paragraphs.orig: 凡為劫盜者，殺越人干貨，肆暴無忌。今江南人雖或被利心所使，為盜為劫者有之，然下山之盜不殺臣等，且有遺物；仙岩之人不隱所劫，竟還奪鞍，可以觀風氣柔弱，人心不甚暴惡之驗也。
